This document outlines the 
equipment inspection (P1), which must be performed every 6 months..

The technical specification of the 
hydraulic Gov. S/N 6560/61/62 - L2170mm, W = 920 mm, H=2200mm, Q=45/56L/min 
power = 15KW, tank vol =800L

The 
first draft initiated & tested by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohammed general manager of Nag 
Hammadi Hyd. PS, and certified by by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC 
inspection and quality control general director.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل

Wear the appropriate 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask
Stop pumps and switch off the power supply
